name: @magicsword-io/magicsword-mcp
description: MagicSword MCP server — manage MagicSword conversationally from Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP-aware client.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test scripts/verify-release.test.mjs scripts/configure.test.mjs scripts/install-links.test.mjs scripts/policy-rules.test.mjs scripts/policy-rules-stdio.test.mjs scripts/tools-stdio.test.mjs scripts/enforcement.test.mjs scripts/intel-sources.test.mjs scripts/investigate.test.mjs scripts/create-policy.test.mjs && node scripts/client.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm audit
